senses.gloss:
किशल किशल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a sprout, a
shoot.

किसल किसल or किसलय, अस्, अम्, m. n. a
sprout or shoot, the extremity of a branch bearing
new leaves.

किशलय, अस्, अम्, m. n. a young shoot.
—किश-
लय-तल्प, अस्, m. or किशलय-शय्या, f. or किश-
लय-शयन, अम्, n. a bed of young leaves &c.;
see किसल, किसलय, &c.

किशोर किशोर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr.
किम् and rt. शॄ), young, infantine; (अस्), m. a colt,
the young of any animal; the sun; Benjamin or
Styrax benzoin (= तैल-पर्ण्य्-ओषधि); N. of a
Dānava; a youth, a lad, one from his birth to the
end of his fifteenth year, a minor in law (अजात-
व्यवहार) becoming after his fifteenth year subject
to suits at law (or जात-व्यवहार); (ई), f. a maiden,
a young woman.

किष्क् किष्क्, cl. 10. A. किष्कयते, -यि-
तुम्, to injure, kill; (a various reading
for हिष्क् and हिक्क्); [cf. Hib. ceasaim, ‘I torment,
crucify, vex.’]

किष्किन्ध किष्किन्ध, अस्, आ or ई, m. f., N. of
a mountain in the south of India, in Oḍra, containing
a cave, the residence of the monkey-prince Bālin.
—किष्किन्ध-पर्वत, अस्, m., N. of a place.
—किष्किन्धा-काण्ड, अम्, n. title of the fourth
book of the Rāmāyaṇa.
किष्किन्धक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

किष्किन्ध्य, अस्, आ, m. f. (but generally f.), N.
of a mountain and of a district = किष्किन्ध above,
said to be in the peninsula, in the northern part
of Mysore, near the sources of the Pampā river,
the territory of Bālin the monkey-king, from whom
it was conquered by Rāma and transferred to Su-
grīva, the brother of Bāli and rightful king. The
story is told in the fourth book of the Rāmāyaṇa.
The name किष्किन्ध्या is also applied to the capital
city of the district, the mountain being called
Ṛṣya-mūka.
—किष्किन्ध्या-काण्ड, अस्, m. title
of the fourth book of the Rāmāyaṇa; also of the
Adhyātma-rāmāyaṇa.
—किष्किन्ध्याधिप (˚य-
अध्˚), अस्, m. a N. of Bālin, a monkey-king slain
by Rāma.

किष्कु किष्कु, उस्, उस्, उ, vile, bad, con-
temptible; (उस्), m. f. the fore-arm, a cubit, a span;
an instrument for measuring lengths = हस्त or कर
= twenty-four thumbs' breadths = (1/400) of a Nalva.
—किष्कु-पर्वन्, आ, m., N. of several kinds of
reed, as bamboo, sugar-cane, Arundo Tibialis.

किस् किस्, ind., Ved. a particle of interro-
gation, ‘whether, if;’ according to native commen-
tators = कर्तृ, ‘a doer;’ [cf. नकिस्, माकिस्.]

किस किस, अस्, m., N. of an attendant of
the sun.

कीश कीश, अस्, आ, अम्, naked; (अस्, ई), m. f. an
ape, a monkey; a bird; the sun.
—कीश-पर्ण, अस्,
m. the tree Achyranthes Aspera (अपामार्ग); [cf.
केश-पर्णी.]
किसर किसर, अम्, n. an article for sale (?).
किसरिक, अस्, ई, अम्, selling Kisara.

किसलयित, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with leaf-buds
or young shoots; [cf. किशल.]

कीस्त कीस्त, अस्, m., Ved. one who praises,
a singer, a poet; (related to कीर्ति?).
